paragraphs: Sanhedrin 17b says that they are Rav Huna and Rav Chisda.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Sanhedrin17b scalar explicitly identifies the Elders of Sura as Rav Huna and Rav Chisda. It supports expanding ר״ה to Rav Huna in this exact collective formula. No other collective or identity relation from the surrounding list is imported.
